purpose: Working-research completeness checklist against Problem A pp. 1--3; not a final claim of competition completion
scope: Current development research only. Earlier final-set inspection prevents any new claim that the same 121--180 data are unseen.

development_evidence_present: Purchasing-power net wealth, annualized log growth and real CAGR
Annual-endpoint MDD, tail exceedance/excess and CVaR diagnostics separate large loss from ordinary volatility
Three static products, transparent profile-horizon-specific assignment or Review
Explicit policy uncertainty and alternative inner-screen calibration
pending_for_final_answer: Choose and freeze one coherent three-product/onboarding policy without treating exploratory alternatives as simultaneous final recommendations
State what liquidity labels can and cannot identify, and give brief A--E explanations
Clarify whether each portfolio uses all three assets, given zero-weight possibilities in explored long-only menus

development_evidence_present: Frozen OOF Balanced client C uses its stated 30-year horizon, with annual/hold/myopic/finite execution compared on identical paths and targets
This artifact explicitly restores exact one-third equity/bond/bill annually with the stated fee as the required baseline
Median and P10 real CAGR, median and P90 MDD, actual trade fraction, mean annual log growth, fees, breach counts and CVaR90 pooled from all 120 path metrics
Prespecified annual-policy worst OOF C severe-loss episode, with peak/trough/recovery and actual trades/costs
No-decision-from-evaluation causal execution and finite-horizon approximation checks
pending_for_final_answer: Decide and state whether to adopt automated rebalancing or target-weight updates; a hold-versus-restore gate keeps its target fixed and is not a target-change rule
Provide one customer-facing explanation of at most 50 English words for a trade, target change or human review
Select the coherent final policy and define its authorized final evaluation; this development table does not supply the required final 121--180 assessment or decide a gate winner

development_evidence_present: Modeling-assumption diagnostics include synthetic-market dependence/annual stationarity concerns, fee-observation MDD sensitivity and finite-mesh execution approximation
Known final-set exposure, small effective evidence samples, liquidity nonidentification and risk transfer from static to dynamic policies have been recorded
pending_for_final_answer: Tie one chosen assumption/cost diagnostic to the actual frozen main recommendation and explicitly say whether that recommendation changes
Freeze the important limitation, precise human-review/suspension trigger, and pending-review action; do not promise a fresh annual reset of the whole-horizon risk budget

submission: Concise recommendation must cover all three portfolios, A--E, Balanced updates and main safeguard
English report at most 10 A4 pages, font at least 11pt, members named
AI use disclosure and independently checked calculations/code/references
Source/supplement ZIP at most 50 MB; preserve dataset/problem CC BY-NC-SA attribution and license requirements
interpretation: A development experiment can address an item without resolving the final modeling decision. No safeguard or gate is adopted by this checklist.
